skills.description_en: Use when customer deliverables need contract-criteria checks, exception and remedy handling, customer review, or sign-off preparation; not for delivery tracking, invoicing, payment, or renewal.
skills.description_zh: 负责交付物检查、异常处理和客户签署准备；不负责项目跟踪、发票付款或续约。

skills.description_en: Use when a negotiated customer contract needs version reconciliation, approval routing, signatory-authority review, signature readiness, or execution evidence; not for negotiation or project delivery.
skills.description_zh: 核验合同版本、文件指纹、双方主体、签署权限、审批、谈判偏差和关键条款；仅判断是否可进入人工签署，不自动签署或发送。

skills.description_en: Use when a potential customer, partner, referral, inquiry, or target account needs a traceable lead record before discovery; not for requirement confirmation, opportunity scoring, or outreach execution.
skills.description_zh: 记录客户线索来源、潜在需求、联系依据、负责人和下一步；未经授权不得抓取个人信息、联系客户或把假设写成事实。

skills.description_en: Use when a proposal, scope, price, service level, risk allocation, or contract term needs negotiation preparation or a traceable session record; not for quotation creation or contract signature.
skills.description_zh: 明确谈判目标、权限和底线，记录双方立场、让步、交换条件、未决问题与审批；未经授权不得承诺价格、范围或合同条款。

skills.description_en: Use when confirmed customer needs require an opportunity score, pursuit review, pipeline priority recommendation, or qualification decision packet; not for discovery, solution pricing, or negotiation.
skills.description_zh: 按战略匹配、需求清晰度、决策人触达、预算准备度、时间准备度和交付匹配度评估商机；评分只供人工决策，不自动判定客户价值。

skills.description_en: Use when a signed customer project needs contract-linked milestone, change, blocker, risk, and delivery-status tracking; not for customer acceptance or renewal.
skills.description_zh: 按合同和里程碑跟踪项目交付、完成度、证据、逾期、阻塞、变更与风险；不得虚构进度、擅改范围或代替客户验收。

skills.description_en: Use when an accepted customer contract approaches renewal and needs renewal evaluation, options, scope and price proposal, quotation, or follow-up tracking; not for acceptance or contract signature.
skills.description_zh: 负责续约评估、续约方案、报价和续约跟踪；不负责业务验收或合同签署。

skills.description_en: Use when a customer discovery meeting, needs interview, requirement clarification, or follow-up confirmation needs preparation or documentation; not for lead creation or opportunity scoring.
skills.description_zh: 准备并记录客户需求沟通，区分客户原话、内部理解、假设和已确认需求，形成责任明确的下一步；不得虚构沟通或替客户确认。

skills.description_en: Use when a qualified opportunity needs a solution scope, proposal, pricing model, line-item quotation, or quote-version review; not for opportunity scoring, negotiation, or contract signing.
skills.description_zh: 根据已确认需求形成方案与报价草案，核对范围、交付、币种、折扣、税费和有效期；不得擅自定价、承诺或向客户发送。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved financial event needs account classification, draft journal entries, debit-credit validation, source tracing, or posting preparation; not for payment approval or reporting.
skills.description_zh: 根据已批准业务凭证生成记账草案，并检查借贷平衡、币种、会计期间和来源证据。

skills.description_en: Use when a purchase or expense needs budget balance, funding source, budget account, approval threshold, and availability checks; not for creating the budget or approving the expense.
skills.description_zh: 核对预算余额、资金来源、预算科目、审批阈值和预算可用性；采购可调用，但归属财务，检查结果不等于批准支出。

skills.description_en: Use when a department needs a new budget, revision, forecast baseline, or approval-ready plan for a financial period; not for checking one transaction’s budget availability.
skills.description_zh: 制定和修订部门预算，明确预算科目、假设、责任人、风险和审批路线。

skills.description_en: Use when an employee or department needs a traceable spending, reimbursement, supplier-purchase, or commitment request; not for budget availability checks, policy review, or payment.
skills.description_zh: 将部门或员工的支出需求整理为包含预算、用途、金额和证据的标准费用申请。

skills.description_en: Use when a submitted expense or reimbursement needs policy, evidence, duplicate, conflict, and approval review after a finance budget check; not for recalculating budget availability or approving payment.
skills.description_zh: 审核费用申请的制度合规性、预算余额、证明材料、重复风险和职责分离情况。

skills.description_en: Use when an invoice or supplier bill needs arithmetic, supplier, PO/contract, delivery-acceptance, expense, currency, and duplicate checks; not for payment approval or official tax authentication.
skills.description_zh: 核验发票必填字段、金额税额、费用申请匹配度和重复风险，但不代替税务机关验真。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved expense and verified invoice need a payment packet, payee and duplicate checks, approval routing, or release controls; not for executing payment or accounting.
skills.description_zh: 汇总费用、发票、收款方和职责分离证据，形成待授权的付款审批材料。

skills.description_en: Use when posted finance data must be summarized, compared with budget, reconciled to cash, or prepared as a period management report; not for posting entries or approving payment.
skills.description_zh: 汇总预算、收入、支出、现金、应收和应付数据，生成带勾稽差异与证据覆盖率的财务报告草案。

skills.description_en: Use when authorized HR users need minimum employee-record queries, skill/KPI/training updates, personnel statistics, or audit history; not for candidate screening or onboarding decisions.
skills.description_zh: 管理员工基本信息、技能、KPI和培训记录，并为每次数据变更保留审计日志。

skills.description_en: Use when shortlisted candidates need interview logistics, notices, interviewer assignment, structured scorecards, and feedback consolidation; not for resume screening or offer issuance.
skills.description_zh: 安排面试、生成通知与六维评估表，并汇总形成可审计的面试决策材料。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved role brief must become a canonical, bilingual, or channel-adaptable job description; not for approving headcount or publishing the role.
skills.description_zh: 根据已审批的岗位需求生成适配不同招聘渠道的职位描述。

skills.description_en: Use when a manager requests headcount, proposes opening a role, or needs a hiring request clarified and approved; not for writing or publishing the JD.
skills.description_zh: 收集并分析岗位需求，形成可审批的岗位需求说明书。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved finalist needs compensation validation, a draft offer, version tracking, or verified acceptance recording; not for candidate selection or onboarding before acceptance.
skills.description_zh: 校验薪资与录用审批，生成Offer草案并跟踪版本及候选人状态。

skills.description_en: Use when a candidate has verified offer acceptance and needs preboarding, access, a 30/60/90-day plan, training, or probation review; not for issuing offers or maintaining general employee records.
skills.description_zh: 管理新员工入职清单、30/60/90天计划、试用期反馈与转正评估。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved JD needs channel adaptation, publication preflight, tracking fields, or confirmed publication recording; not for changing role criteria or screening applicants.
skills.description_zh: 将已审批JD适配到招聘平台、内推和社交渠道，并生成渠道跟踪表。

skills.description_en: Use when resumes or candidate profiles need evidence-based screening against approved role criteria and a shortlist review packet; not for scheduling interviews or deciding final selection.
skills.description_zh: 按五个岗位相关维度筛选简历，输出证据、评分、排名与信息缺口。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved supplier selection needs contract terms, version control, deviation review, legal or finance approval routing, and signature preparation; not for creating or releasing a PO.
skills.description_zh: 根据选商结果生成合同条款与版本，完成偏差和审批准备；不生成采购订单，也不自动签署。

skills.description_en: Use when arrived goods or completed services need quantity, condition, quality, document, and acceptance-criteria checks; not for delivery tracking, invoice verification, or payment approval.
skills.description_zh: 对照合同和订单检查交付数量、时间、状态、质量与文件，记录差异和证据；最终验收、拒收或例外接收由授权人员决定。

skills.description_en: Use when a released purchase order needs supplier confirmation, expected delivery, logistics or service milestones, delay, exception, and expediting records; not for accepting delivery.
skills.description_zh: 跟踪订单确认、预计交付、物流或服务里程碑、延期、异常和催交记录；不负责收货或验收。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved procurement contract needs a purchase-order draft, line and total validation, approval routing, release control, or PO status record; not for drafting contract terms.
skills.description_zh: 根据已批准合同生成采购订单，校验 PO 内容、审批、释放和状态记录；不负责合同条款设计。

skills.description_en: Use when RFQ responses need completeness checks, line normalization, currency and commercial-term comparison, or a comparison table; not for qualification, composite supplier scoring, or selection.
skills.description_zh: 只负责报价完整性、行项目、币种、税费、运费、折扣、付款与交付条款的标准化商业比较，不负责供应商综合评分或选商。

skills.description_en: Use when a business need must become a versioned, supplier-neutral procurement requirement before finance budget checking; not for technical specification approval, sourcing, or ordering.
skills.description_zh: 将业务采购需求整理为可追踪、可比较、供应商中立的需求文件，明确规格、验收标准、证据缺口与审批状态。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved procurement requirement and admitted supplier list need an RFQ draft, inquiry scope, quotation template, deadline, and recipient list; not for sending or comparing quotes.
skills.description_zh: 根据采购需求和技术规格生成 RFQ、询价范围、报价模板、截止日期与供应商发送清单；不负责发送或比价。

skills.description_en: Use when completed deliveries or review periods need post-award supplier performance evaluation, improvement planning, or rating review; not for pre-award qualification, scoring, or selection.
skills.description_zh: 基于交付、质量、服务、商务表现和合规证据评价供应商，展示评分与证据覆盖率；不得自动续约、停用或拉黑。

skills.description_en: Use when discovered supplier candidates need qualification, compliance, risk, capacity, and admission checks; not for supplier discovery, quote scoring, award, or post-delivery evaluation.
skills.description_zh: 对候选供应商进行资质、合规、风险、能力和准入检查；不负责搜索、报价评分、选商或履约评价。

skills.description_en: Use when qualified suppliers need an evidence-backed pre-award score across qualification, price, delivery, quality, and risk; not for quote normalization, selection, or post-delivery evaluation.
skills.description_zh: 综合资质、价格、交付、质量与风险形成供应商评分表；与报价标准化和最终选商分离。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved, budget-cleared procurement requirement needs supplier discovery and a traceable candidate list; not for qualification, scoring, selection, or supplier outreach.
skills.description_zh: 根据已确认需求搜索潜在供应商并形成候选名单，只负责发现与去重，不负责资质准入、评分或选商。

skills.description_en: Use when qualification, commercial comparison, and supplier scores need an award recommendation or selection decision packet; not for scoring, contracting, or order release.
skills.description_zh: 基于供应商资质、报价比较、风险与利益冲突证据形成选商建议；最终选择和例外批准必须由授权人员决定。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved technical task requires code, configuration, infrastructure, integration, migration, or implementation with test evidence; not for final test acceptance or release.
skills.description_zh: 按已批准任务实施代码、配置或系统变更，遵循测试先行、最小范围、可回滚和证据交付；不得自动声称评审、合并或部署完成。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved technology requirement needs option comparison, prototype planning, dependency and risk analysis, estimates, or a go/no-go packet; not for specification confirmation or design.
skills.description_zh: 从技术、运维、安全隐私、人员、周期、成本、依赖和迁移角度评估可行性，形成有证据的方案比较与人工立项建议。

skills.description_en: Use when a running system needs monitoring review, incident triage, diagnosis, mitigation, recovery validation, root-cause analysis, or planned maintenance; not for release readiness.
skills.description_zh: 负责系统监控、故障响应、诊断、缓解、恢复验证、根因分析和计划维护；严重级别、生产操作、对外沟通与关闭必须由授权人员决定。

skills.description_en: Use when a business need, product change, integration, infrastructure request, or operational problem needs a versioned, solution-neutral technology requirement; not for feasibility or specification approval.
skills.description_zh: 将业务或运维需求整理为可追踪、可测试的技术需求，明确范围、功能、质量属性、依赖、风险和验收标准，避免过早锁定方案。

skills.description_en: Use when approved technical specifications need architecture, components, data flow, deployment, observability, resilience, migration, and rollback design; not for confirming requirements or technical thresholds.
skills.description_zh: 完成架构、组件、数据流、部署、可观测性、韧性、迁移和回滚方案；不重新定义技术规格与验收阈值。

skills.description_en: Use when a feasible technology requirement needs confirmed performance, interface, compatibility, security, acceptance, and procurement technical parameters; not for architecture design or implementation.
skills.description_zh: 确认性能、接口、兼容性、安全、验收指标和采购技术参数；不负责架构、组件、部署或回滚方案。

skills.description_en: Use when an accepted system version needs release readiness, deployment control, health checks, monitoring, backup, rollback, change-window, and status evidence; not for testing or routine maintenance.
skills.description_zh: 核验系统版本、不可变制品、测试验收、审批、变更窗口、上线步骤、健康检查、监控、备份与回滚方案；不得自动执行生产发布。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved technical design needs owned, estimable, dependency-aware, testable implementation tasks or a delivery plan; not for architecture design or implementation.
skills.description_zh: 将已批准的技术方案拆解为可执行、可估算、可验收的任务，明确负责人、交付物、依赖关系和完成标准，避免循环或隐藏依赖。

skills.description_en: Use when an implementation or system version needs reproducible test aggregation, gate checks, defect review, and human acceptance input; not for implementation or release execution.
skills.description_zh: 汇总并复核测试套件、通过率、覆盖率、缺陷和证据，形成测试验收建议；自动门禁通过不等于人工验收或生产发布批准。
